::: {#def-no-interference .theorem}
## No interference

No variable in a given observational unit is a parent of a non-equivalent variable in another unit:

$$
X\notin\mathbf{Pa}(Y)\qquad\forall\ X\in\mathscr{O}_i,\ Y\in\mathscr{O}_j,\ X\not\sim Y,\ i\neq j.
$$

With no contagion (C.14), $\mathcal{G}$ then has no edge between units, so no counterfactual of one unit depends on what a regime sets in another.
:::
